capabilities: Pair a vault with a Zima account and Topic via a single-use connection link
Mirror file creates, edits, renames, and deletions from Obsidian to Zima
Choose between continuous syncing and a one-time snapshot
Manually paste a connection link when protocol links are unavailable
Disconnect by forgetting the local device credential and revoking it in Zima
extras: README details exactly what data is sent to the Zima server (file contents, paths, sizes, vault and device names) and states there is no analytics or telemetry; plain HTTP is only accepted for localhost servers, otherwise HTTPS is required. Disconnecting does not delete already-mirrored files.
problem: Obsidian notes live in local files that Zima cannot access, so there is no built-in way to make vault content available in a Zima Topic.

relations.evidence: mirrors an Obsidian vault into the currently selected Zima Topic

summary: One-way sync plugin that mirrors an Obsidian vault, including attachments, into a selected Zima Topic.
